approval_required_for: Any architecture, pipeline, stream/lane ordering, memory layout, runtime ABI, DDR map, numeric policy, or major template/code-generation change discovered during verification_artifact refinement.
Any change to Qwen2 decoder semantics, GQA/KV grouping, RoPE, causal masking, sequence bounds, operator order, residual placement, RMSNorm placement, or MLP gate/up/activation/down ordering.
Any change to golden-reference generation, numeric tolerance, fp16/fp32 cast points, rounding, saturation, residual precision, or real-weight/input acceptance criteria.
Any backend/app-shell target selection, board profile update, or shell integration choice not grounded in cited board materials and real Vivado/tool evidence.
Any attempt to reopen or invalidate previously ready Stage4/Stage5 outcomes without contradictory current tool evidence.

executable_actions.on_failure: Stop downstream progress and preserve a contamination guard; do not promote the stale report or retry from ambiguous risk evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: The stage failed with a planner-reported current-stage risk status, while the stale report is incomplete and unpromoted. A bounded audit must extract the exact 3 unresolved risks, assess cached sub-agent reuse, and prevent failed artifacts from becoming downstream inputs.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not modify generated code, golden outputs, tolerances, memory/runtime ABI, or board target assumptions. Emit a bounded retry/backtrack request with the failed checker evidence and keep downstream stages blocked.
executable_actions.rationale: Resolve only the current-stage verification planning/contract risks identified by the failed planner. The refinement must preserve validated Stage4/Stage5 design facts and maintain the leaf, single-layer, and board AXI/DDR verification hierarchy.

executable_actions.on_failure: Do not promote retry outputs. Because the bounded per-stage retry budget would be exhausted, halt downstream progression and create an explicit SACG retry/backtrack or contamination-barrier record from the failed checker evidence.
executable_actions.rationale: Attempt 1 of 2 failed, and no SACG-memory blockers are active. After audit and bounded refinement, rerun the current verification_artifacts gate and promote only freshly passing artifacts.

proposed_actions: Hold downstream progression; do not start debug_loop or backend_board from the failed verification_artifacts attempt.
Run a bounded current-stage failure audit that quarantines stale outputs and extracts the exact unresolved planner risks from the full LLM result and command log.

Refine only the verification_artifacts contracts/plans needed to resolve those current-stage risks, preserving validated code_generation, numeric, memory, runtime, and model decisions unless an explicit approval/backtrack request is produced.
Rerun verification_artifacts once under the bounded attempt policy and promote outputs only if all current-stage static, hierarchy, contract, SACG-reference, and trust-barrier checks pass.
If the bounded retry fails, keep downstream blocked and create an explicit SACG retry/backtrack or contamination-barrier record instead of reusing failed artifacts.

Using the stale incomplete verification_artifacts_report.json as a validated input would contaminate downstream artifacts.

Transient LLM endpoint failures may recur; because LLM planning is mandatory, fallback or static-script promotion is not acceptable.
Skipping the required leaf -> single-layer -> board AXI/DDR verification hierarchy would risk promoting higher-layer evidence before lower-layer contracts are sound.
